Plugins_Xplorer2_EnableInlineSearchDesc: Allow double-clicking or pressing hotkeys in xplorer2 to summon inline search
Plugins_Xplorer2_EnableQuickNavDesc: Allow middle-clicking in xplorer2's file list to summon the Quick Navigation menu
Xplorer2_PluginDesc: xplorer2 integration plugin. Reads the active pane's path and provides quick directory jumping in xplorer2.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_Xplorer2PathCollector: Reads and tracks the folder in xplorer2's active pane. Other open tabs are left out: xplorer2 unloads inactive tabs and exposes no way to read them.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_Xplorer2InlineSearchAda: Provides inline typing filter navigation and directory jumping for xplorer2's file list panes.
